name: ffwf-tau-code
description: Clients for the tau agent harness's `tau serve` HTTP edge: a web client (served by tau itself), and a VS Code extension (being ported).
//internal-deps: The five @ffwf/tau-code-* packages depend on each other by `*`, not by version. None of them is published to npm and none is meant to be (ARCHITECTURE 9.1), so a range npm cannot resolve from the registry is the only kind that works: an exact pin links the workspace only while the two numbers happen to agree, and silently becomes an unresolvable registry fetch the moment a release bumps one of them. `*` always matches the sibling on disk. Do not 'correct' these to the current version.
//workspaces: Order matters: npm builds workspaces in this order, and each package builds against the dist of the ones before it. packages/vscode is NOT a workspace while the port to τ 0.16 is under way: it is written against serve protocol 0.11 (a WebSocket, a daemon of many sessions) and does not build against protocol 1. It comes back with Phase R (ROADMAP.md). packages/runtime ships a payload and imports nothing here, so it still builds.

scripts.check: npm run check:protocol && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run smoke && npm run smoke:browser
scripts.clean: tsc --build --clean && rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/dist-types packages/web-py/src/tau_web/dist dist-py
